story.iWant: I want to create and manage "class sections" within my classes,
story.soThat: So that I can further organize my study materials by topic or module.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: **Given** I have created a class **When** I create a new section within that class **Then** the section is added to my class. **And** I can rename and delete existing sections. **And** when I delete a section, I receive a confirmation dialog stating that all associated content will also be deleted. **And** section names shall be limited to 25 alphanumeric characters. **And** if a user attempts to create a section with a name that already exists within the same class, the system shall display an error message: 'A section with this name already exists in this class. Please choose a different name.'

constraint.description: Row Level Security (RLS) must be enabled on the `class_sections` table in Supabase to ensure strict data isolation, allowing users to only access their own class sections.
Section names shall be limited to 25 alphanumeric characters.
When a class section is deleted, all associated content (documents, generated content) must also be deleted (cascading delete).

If a user attempts to create a section with a name that already exists within the same class, the system shall display an error message: 'A section with this name already exists in this class. Please choose a different name.'

tests.standards: The project utilizes Jest with `jest-environment-jsdom` and React Testing Library for comprehensive unit and integration testing. A strict "no-flaky-tests" policy is enforced to maintain test reliability. Critical security measures, such as Row Level Security (RLS) policies, are also verified through automated tests.

ideas.idea: Verify a new section can be successfully created within a class.
Verify an existing section can be renamed.
Verify an existing section can be deleted, and a confirmation dialog is displayed.
Verify all associated content (documents, generated content) is deleted when a section is deleted (cascading delete).
Verify section names are limited to 25 alphanumeric characters.
Verify an error message is displayed if a user attempts to create a section with a name that already exists within the same class.
Verify only the authenticated user can create/manage their own sections (RLS enforcement).
